text_blocks.snippet: The cost of diabetes medication without insurance can be quite high, potentially ranging from hundreds to thousands of dollars per month, depending on the specific medication and dosage. For example, Ozempic (semaglutide) can cost $1,000 to $1,200 or more per month without insurance, while Rybelsus (semaglutide) can range from $1,100 to $1,240. Mounjaro (tirzepatide) can cost between $1,000 and $1,200, according to GoodRx. Generic metformin, a common Type 2 diabetes medication, may be more affordable, but even then, costs can vary.
snippet_highlighted_words: hundreds to thousands of dollars per month

list.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists:

list.title: Metformin:
list.snippet: While generally more affordable, the cost of metformin can vary depending on the dosage form (tablet vs. liquid) and brand.

list.title: Other Medications:
list.snippet: Sulfonylureas and SGLT-2 inhibitors, often used alongside insulin and metformin, can also add to the overall cost.

list.title: Insurance Status:
list.snippet: Having insurance can significantly lower the cost of diabetes medications through copays, coinsurance, or other coverage options.

list.title: Pharmacy:
list.snippet: Prices can vary between pharmacies, so comparing prices at different locations is recommended.

list.title: Medication Type and Dosage:
list.snippet: Brand-name medications and higher dosages generally cost more than generic options or lower dosages.

list.title: Patient Assistance Programs:
list.snippet: Some pharmaceutical companies offer patient assistance programs or savings cards that can help reduce costs.

list.title: GoodRx and Other Coupons:
list.snippet: Websites like GoodRx offer coupons and discounts that can significantly lower the price of medications.
Explore Generic Options: If appropriate for your condition, generic medications can be a more affordable alternative.
Use Coupons and Discount Programs: Check websites like GoodRx for potential savings.

Consider Patient Assistance Programs: Check if your medication manufacturer offers a patient assistance program.
